title: Editor-preview pin claims 'byte-identical' but compares approximately
evidence:
+	check(_same(boot_positions, regen_positions), "regenerate reproduces the boot world byte-identically")
+	for i in pa.size():
+		if not pa[i].is_equal_approx(pb[i]):
+			return false
detail: Check message and file docblock say byte-identical, but _same uses Vector3.is_equal_approx; small float drift passes. Snapshot also covers only child counts and positions.
recommended_fix: Compare exactly (==) or hash the staging, or reword the check and docblock to 'approximately identical'. As written the pin cannot catch the drift it claims to.

title: Autoload guard is vacuous: has_setting("autoload") is always false in Godot
evidence:
+	if not ProjectSettings.has_setting("autoload"):
+		check(true, "no autoloads registered at all")
+	else:
+		var autoloads: Dictionary = ProjectSettings.get_setting("autoload")
+		check(not autoloads.has("Sim"), "no Sim autoload registered")
detail: Godot registers autoloads as 'autoload/<name>' settings; a bare 'autoload' setting never exists, so the first branch always runs — the Sim-autoload guard is dead code and the pass is unconditional.
recommended_fix: Test ProjectSettings.has_setting("autoload/Sim") directly (or iterate autoload/* keys) and delete the unreachable else branch cargo-culted from the deleted _no_sim_state.

title: Spec front-matter says status done; every task checkbox is unchecked
evidence:

+- [ ] `scripts/sim/sim_balance.gd` + `scripts/sim/sim_core.gd` -- deterministic core (state, RNG, routing, tick, commands, hash) -- E2.1/E2.2 foundation
detail: Front-matter declares status done while all eight execution checkboxes remain '- [ ]' — the artifact contradicts itself on completion state.
recommended_fix: Mark completed tasks [x] or set status to the true state before committing the artifact.

title: View-purity and editor-preview pins lack the mutation leg the spec requires
evidence: +- Given the headless suite runs, when it completes, then every E2 test contract passes with exit 0, each new pin proven by a mutation leg (flipping the mechanism turns it red).
detail: test_view_purity.gd and test_editor_preview.gd contain no leg proving their pins can fail; test_sim_replay and test_sim_sla have explicit legs. View purity is an E2 Always-contract, so these pins could be vacuous.
recommended_fix: Add a leg that injects a sim-writing view call and asserts the hash diverges (mirroring _seed_divergence), so the purity pin is provably non-vacuous.

title: Drop-attributability check claims class/tick validation but never checks them
evidence:
+	var attributable := true
+	for d in sim.drops:
+		if int(d.pipe) < 0 or int(d.node) < 0 or str(d.reason) != "queue_overflow":
+			attributable = false
+	check(attributable, "SLA: every drop record names pipe, node, class, tick and reason")
detail: The loop validates pipe, node, and reason only; class and tick are never inspected despite the assertion text listing them.
recommended_fix: Extend the loop to assert d.cls and d.tick are present and valid, or trim the check message to pipe, node, reason.

title: Comment says '8 parallel' but the loop adds 7 pipes
evidence:
+	for i in 7: # 8 parallel — budget headroom for all three admissions in one tick
+		sim.apply_command({"cmd": "add_pipe", "a": 0, "b": 9})
detail: 'for i in 7' iterates seven times, creating seven pipes; the inline comment claims eight.
recommended_fix: Change the comment to '7 parallel' or the loop bound to 8 — the current pair disagrees by one.
